messages:
maya: Quick q — for the new analytics namespace, should we create a namespaced Role + RoleBinding for the service account or reuse an existing ClusterRole? Also how should we wire IRSA for S3 reads — annotate the namespace or the SA?

liam: Prefer a namespaced Role + RoleBinding unless multiple namespaces truly need identical perms. Important: IRSA annotation belongs on the ServiceAccount, not the Namespace. Example SA manifest: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: analytics-svc
  namespace: analytics
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Analytics-S3ReadOnly
```
That IAM role should be created with the proper trust policy for the cluster OIDC provider.

noah: On the Terraform side you'll need an aws_iam_role + attachment + the k8s service account resource (or the eks module's irsa support). Quick snippet: 
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "analytics_irsa" {
  name = "redwood-analytics-irsa"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.irsa.json
}

resource "kubernetes_service_account" "analytics_sa" {
  metadata {
    name = "analytics-svc"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.analytics.metadata[0].name
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.analytics_irsa.arn
    }
  }
}
```
Make sure the cluster has an OIDC provider set up (aws_iam_openid_connect_provider). If not, create it via the eks module.

sophia: Also think through RBAC surface: the Role should be explicit about allowed resources (secrets/configmaps/pods/logs). For analytics pods we likely need get/list/watch on objects and get on secrets that hold credentials.

deploy-bot: CI note: infra CI will run a validation that serviceAccount annotations match the expected pattern (eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn) and block any PRs that try to embed AWS creds in k8s secrets.

maya: Cool, I'll open a PR to add the SA + Role + RoleBinding + IAM role + policy attachments and update the Helm chart values for analytics. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/982 (WIP)

liam: :thumbsup: When you add the RoleBinding, remember it must reference the SA as the subject: 
```yaml
kind: RoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: analytics-access
  namespace: analytics
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: analytics-svc
  namespace: analytics
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: analytics-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

noah: One gotcha we hit elsewhere: if someone manually annotates the namespace or uses legacy kube2iam/kiam assumptions it won't work — IRSA relies on the SA annotation and the IAM OIDC trust. Confirm `data.aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.cluster` exists in terraform or the eks module created it.

sophia: Also add a simple e2e that launches a pod with the new SA and checks STS:GetCallerIdentity via aws-sdk to ensure the mapped role is assumed. Saves time troubleshooting.

maya: Action items from me: create the IAM role + policy, create k8s SA manifest with annotation, Role + RoleBinding in analytics namespace, update Helm chart values, add CI unit test + e2e smoke test, and include migration steps for existing pods. I'll tag you in the PR for review.
